title: Seeking Strength, Acceptance, and Inner Peace
arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ امْنَحْنِيَ الْقُوَّةَ لِأُقَاوِمَ نَفْسِيْ ، وَالشَّجَاعَةَ لِأُوَاجِهَ ضَعْفِيْ ، وَالْيَقِيْنَ لِأَتَقَبَّلَ قَدَرِيْ ، وَالرِّضَا لِيَرْتَاحَ عَقْلِيْ ، وَالْفَهْمَ لِيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِيْ
transliteration: Allāhumma-mnḥannil-quwwata li'uqāwima nafsī, wash-shajāʿata li'uwājiha ḍaʿfī, wal-yaqīna li'ataqabbala qadarī, war-riḍā liyartāḥa ʿaqlī, wal-fahma liyaṭma'inna qalbī
translation: Oh Allah! Grant me the strength to oppose myself, the courage to face my weakness, the conviction to accept my fate, the satisfaction to relax my mind, and the understanding to reassure my heart.
reference: A personal supplication inspired by Islamic values; not found in canonical hadith
